en.name: Sunflower seeds, raw, hulled
en.summary: Raw, unsalted, hulled sunflower seeds keep 12 months in a cool, dry, dark cupboard. Being raw is what buys them that year — roasting the same seed starts the oil oxidising and shortens the window considerably.
en.pantry: 12 months in an airtight, opaque container, cool and away from the hob. A hulled sunflower seed is small and soft and carries a lot of polyunsaturated oil, but it has not been heated, so oxidation has barely begun. Keep it that way: light is as much of a problem as warmth, so an opaque jar or a tin beats a clear one on a bright shelf, and the seeds should be kept dry because a damp jar is where mould starts.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for raw hulled sunflower seeds. Cold does them no harm at all and it is a sensible place for a large bag in a hot, humid kitchen, since the failure here is oxidation and low temperature slows it. There is simply no published number to attach to it, so treat cold storage as good practice rather than a documented limit. Seal them well; the seeds pick up other foods' smells.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either. Freezing is harmless — there is very little water in the seed — and it is the obvious home for a bulk sack you will use slowly, but again there is no figure to quote. Bag them airtight with the air pressed out, portion them, and let the bag warm sealed before opening.
en.thawing: No thawing needed. Let a chilled or frozen container reach room temperature before opening so condensation does not settle on the seeds.
spoilage: A bitter, sharp taste — rancid sunflower oil, which is unmistakable.
A smell of old cooking oil or paint rather than something faintly green.
Seeds that are limp and chewy instead of crisp.
Mould, a musty smell or moths in a jar that got damp.
tips: Buy raw rather than roasted if you want the longer shelf life and toast as you go.
Use an opaque airtight jar; light drives rancidity as surely as heat.
Taste a few before folding them into bread or granola.
Keep the bulk cold and a small working jar in the cupboard.

faq.q: How long do raw sunflower seeds keep?
faq.a: 12 months in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark cupboard.

faq.q: Do raw sunflower seeds need refrigerating?
faq.a: No refrigerated timeline is published for them. Cold does slow the oil down and is sensible for a large bag in a hot kitchen, but the cupboard figure assumes no refrigeration.

faq.q: How can you tell if sunflower seeds have gone bad?
faq.a: Taste a few. Rancid sunflower seeds are sharply bitter, and the bitterness carries straight into bread or granola made with them.

zh.name: 生葵瓜子仁（無鹽、去殼）
zh.summary: 生的、無鹽的去殼葵瓜子仁，放在陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃可放 12 個月。能有這一年，靠的就是「生的」這件事——同一顆種子烘過之後，油脂開始氧化，窗口會縮短不少。
zh.pantry: 不透光的氣密容器，陰涼、遠離爐台，12 個月。去殼的葵瓜子仁小而軟，多元不飽和油脂含量高，但它沒有被加熱過，氧化幾乎還沒開始。請讓它保持這樣：光線和溫度一樣麻煩，所以不透光的罐子或鐵罐勝過放在明亮層架上的透明罐；同時要保持乾燥，因為受潮的罐子正是霉菌的起點。
zh.fridge: 去殼生葵瓜子仁沒有公布的冷藏期限。低溫對它完全無害，在又熱又濕的廚房裡，大包裝放冷藏是合理的選擇，因為這裡的失效是氧化，而低溫會拖慢它。只是沒有任何公開數字可以掛上去，所以請把低溫保存當成好習慣，而不是有憑有據的上限。請確實密封，它很會吸別的食物的味道。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據。冷凍無害——種子含水極少——而且慢慢用的大袋裝，冷凍是很明顯的歸宿；但一樣沒有數字可以引用。請壓出空氣密封裝袋、分裝，並且維持密封回溫再打開。
zh.thawing: 不需要解凍。請讓冰過或凍過的容器回到室溫再打開，免得結露落在種子上。
spoilage: 嚐起來苦而尖銳——那是葵花油油耗，很好認。
聞起來像久放的油或油漆，而不是淡淡的青草味。
受潮的罐子長霉、有霉味或出現穀蛾。
tips: 想要比較長的保存期就買生的，要用時才烘。
用不透光的氣密罐；光線催出油耗的力道和溫度一樣大。
揉進麵包或拌進麥片前，先吃幾顆確認。
大量低溫保存，櫥櫃只放一小罐日常用。

faq.a: 氣密容器放陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，12 個月。
它沒有公布的冷藏期限。低溫確實會拖慢油脂變化，熱廚房裡的大包裝這麼做很合理，但櫥櫃那個數字的前提本來就是不冷藏。
吃幾顆。油耗的葵瓜子苦得很尖銳，而且那個苦味會原封不動進到麵包或麥片裡。
